prompt_text: Write a Python solution for the GeeksforGeeks problem Longest Beautiful Substring.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution fails when multiple substrings have the same maximum length because it does not enforce choosing the substring with the smallest starting index.
bug_analysis.root_cause: Missing condition to handle equal length substrings with earlier start index.
bug_analysis.bug_location: Update condition inside main loop when comparing substring lengths

test_failures.details: Fails on cases where multiple valid substrings exist and earliest index is required.

improvement_strategy.improved_prompt: Ensure the solution handles tie-breaking by choosing the smallest starting index when multiple substrings have the same maximum length.
improvement_strategy.improvements_made: Add condition to compare starting index when lengths are equal.
